goals.title: Become financial discipline and responsible
goals.description: Enforce a strict "Pay Yourself First" rule by routing 20% of all monthly income to savings immediately. Conduct monthly financial audits on digital statements to eliminate impulse spending and counter procrastination.
goals.success_metric: Save a set target of R1,000+ per month and successfully complete 12 consecutive monthly digital spending audits.
